item: Replacement EVA backpack battery chargers matched to each backpack model
rationale: Two of the three suit-backpack battery trickle chargers were inoperative on arrival, and engineers spent Sols 1-2 on suit rehabilitation. The brief's lesson is to source replacement chargers matched to the backpack model before the mission.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.1 Technical failures, lines 524-529, 'Lesson for Hypatia III' column; also pre-mission checklist §1.3, line 75 and §2.4 EVA suits and comms, line 289
